title: Bound on Cloned Scope Collision Probability
statement: Let $X$ be a type with decidable equality, let a repeated query scope on $X$ have arity $r$, and let $M$ be a positive integer. When each scope position is assigned an independent uniformly random clone label from $\{1,\ldots,M\}$, the probability that the resulting map from positions to the original query and clone-label pairs is not injective is at most $r^2/M$.
